name.description: Stable role name used as the sase/repos/<name> clone directory and CLI lookup key.

repo.description: Optional owner/repo or bare repository slug. Omit to derive <project>--<name> in the project's organization.

visibility.description: Visibility used when creating a missing sidecar repository.

type.description: The expected type of the argument value

amd_h1_title.description: Optional H1 title used by generated AMD-managed AGENTS.md. SASE-managed projects derive a stable project title when this is null.

amd_agents_template.description: Optional root-relative path to the Jinja2 template used for AMD-managed AGENTS.md files.

amd_agents_minimal_template.description: Optional root-relative path to the Jinja2 template used for create-if-missing minimal AGENTS.md files.

memory_sase_template.description: Optional root-relative path to the Jinja2 template used for generated memory/sase.md files.

memory_readme_template.description: Optional root-relative path to the Jinja2 template used for generated memory/README.md files.

is_sase_managed.description: Explicitly authorize SASE to manage repository resources, including project memory, root AGENTS.md, and SDD initialization. Only the target repository's own sase.yml is consulted.

default_members.description: Project-local sticky defaults for plan-approval member options. Keys are custom role ids and values choose whether each member is default-on.

repro_output_dir.description: Directory where ACE agent repro captures are written. Empty string uses the runtime default.

snippets.description: Snippet expansions for the prompt input (trigger string to expansion text)

tool_calls.description: Tool-call presentation settings for the ACE TUI

slow_threshold_seconds.description: Minimum tool-call duration, in seconds, shown as slow in ACE metadata and timelines

artifact_viewer.description: Settings for ACE's external artifact viewer panes

video.description: mpv-backed terminal video artifact playback settings

vo.description: mpv video output driver for terminal video playback

extra_mpv_args.description: Additional mpv arguments appended after SASE defaults

updates.description: Automatic ACE-session update-check behavior for the Updates tab, badge, and toasts

startup_toast.description: Show an informational toast on ACE startup when SASE core or installed plugins have updates available

startup_toast_max_commits.description: Maximum total incoming commit subjects to show across all repositories in the ACE startup update toast

post_update_toast.description: Show a one-shot confirmation toast after a full SASE self-update restarts ACE into the new version

post_update_toast_diffstat.description: Show per-repository file and line-change stats in the post-update confirmation toast when available

indicator.description: Show a persistent top-bar badge while SASE core or installed plugins have updates available

check_ttl_minutes.description: Minimum age before a cached update status is refreshed during automatic ACE-session checks. This cache TTL is separate from the fixed ten-minute session check cadence and takes precedence over check_ttl_hours when both are set.

check_ttl_hours.description: Legacy/deprecated cache TTL for automatic ACE-session update checks. Prefer check_ttl_minutes, which overrides this when both are set.

incoming_commits.description: Incoming commit previews shown on the ACE Updates tab for SASE core and installed plugin updates

enabled.description: Fetch and show incoming commit subjects for available updates

max_per_repo.description: Maximum incoming commit subjects to display per repository

confirm_max_per_repo.description: Maximum incoming commit subjects to display per repository in update confirmation modals

prompt_completion.description: Live completion settings for the ACE prompt input

auto.description: Automatic prompt completion mode. Use 'soft' for subtitle suggestions or false/off to disable.

debounce_ms.description: Delay in milliseconds before computing live prompt suggestions

auto_file_paths.description: Whether automatic completion may scan file path candidates while typing

auto_xprompt_menu.description: Whether matching #name, #!name, and /skill tokens automatically open the xprompt/skill completion menu while typing

auto_directive_menu.description: Whether matching %name tokens automatically open the directive completion menu while typing

max_auto_rows.description: Maximum automatic completion rows reserved for future popup modes

app.description: Top-level application keybindings (action name to key string)

oneOf.description: Nested key group (e.g., copy mode per-tab keys)

axe.description: Configuration for the axe scheduler daemon

zombie_timeout_seconds.description: Zombie detection timeout in seconds. Hooks and CRS workflows running longer than this are marked as ZOMBIE.

max_agent_runners.description: Maximum concurrent agent runners (agents and mentors)

query.description: Default query filter for axe operations

chop_script_dirs.description: Additional directories to search for chop scripts (searched before PATH lookup)

lumberjack_log_max_bytes.description: Maximum bytes retained for each bounded lumberjack log.

verbose_lumberjack_diagnostics.description: Include verbose lumberjack diagnostics in chop script contexts.

lumberjacks.description: Named lumberjack definitions. Each key is a lumberjack name with interval and chops config.

interval.description: Tick interval in seconds for this lumberjack

chop_timeout.description: Default duration string (e.g., '30s', '5m', '1h') controlling the maximum runtime for chops in this lumberjack

chops.description: List of chop scripts to run on each tick

description.description: Description of what this chop does

agent.description: Agent reference to run instead of a chop script

xprompt.description: XPrompt reference to run instead of a chop script

run_every.description: Duration string (e.g., '60m', '30s', '2h') controlling how often this chop runs

env.description: Environment variables to set when running the chop

timeout.description: Duration string (e.g., '30s', '5m', '1h') controlling the maximum runtime for this chop

update.description: Configuration for SASE self-update and install-mode switching

dev_root.description: Directory where `sase update --to dev` materializes editable checkouts.

mobile_gateway.description: Configuration for the workstation-hosted mobile gateway

bind_address.description: Host address to bind the mobile gateway.

port.description: TCP port for the mobile gateway HTTP API.

state_dir.description: State directory passed to the gateway as the SASE home. Empty string uses the runtime default.

command.description: Gateway command override, parsed without a shell. Empty string uses PATH/sibling-repo discovery.

agent_bridge_command.description: Agent bridge command override passed through to the gateway.

helper_bridge_command.description: Helper bridge command override passed through to the gateway.

push_provider.description: Push notification provider for mobile clients.

fcm_service_account_json.description: Path to a Firebase service account JSON file. Empty string disables file credentials.

fcm_credential_env.description: Environment variable containing Firebase credentials JSON.

fcm_dry_run.description: Send FCM notifications in dry-run mode.

push_timeout_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for each push notification request.

push_retry_limit.description: Number of push notification retry attempts.

startup_timeout_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the gateway to become ready.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum runtime for `sase update --json` before returning exit code 124.

restart_attempts.description: Number of axe start attempts when axe is not running after the update command completes or fails.

metahooks.description: Metahooks intercept failing hooks before the summarize agent runs

hook_command.description: The command that this metahook intercepts

output_regex.description: Regex pattern to match in the hook output

mentor_profiles.description: Mentor profiles define which mentors to apply to which files

profile_name.description: Unique name for this mentor profile

prompt.description: Inline prompt text for the mentor

focus_areas.description: Specific areas this mentor should focus on during review

focus_name.description: Unique identifier for this focus area

description.description: Detailed description of what to look for

file_globs.description: Glob patterns to match files for this profile

diff_regexes.description: Regex patterns to match in the diff output

amend_note_regexes.description: Regex patterns to match in the amend note

first_commit.description: Whether to match on the first commit of a ChangeSpec

projects.description: Only match changespecs belonging to these projects. Auto-populated for local sase.yml profiles.

llm_provider.description: Configuration for the LLM provider abstraction layer

provider.description: Name of the LLM provider to use (e.g., 'agy', 'claude', 'codex'). Leave empty to autodetect an installed provider CLI.

default_effort.description: Default reasoning-effort level applied to agent launches when a prompt does not request one via %effort or a %model:<model>@<effort> suffix. Leave empty for no override (let each provider use its own default). A configured level is best-effort: providers that cannot honor it skip it with a warning.

model_tier_map.description: Mapping from model tiers to specific model identifiers

model_aliases.description: Model alias configuration. builtin contains overrides for SASE role aliases; custom contains user-defined aliases with required descriptions.

builtin.description: Overrides for SASE's builtin model aliases: default, coder, <provider>_coder, epic_lander, and phase_worker. Legacy epic_creator entries are accepted but no longer used by SASE. Values are bare known models, explicit provider/model targets, nested provider-local model paths, or '@<alias>' references.

custom.description: User-defined custom model aliases usable from %model:@<alias> / %m:@<alias>. Each custom alias must include both the target model and a short description shown in completions and the Models panel.

bucket.description: Optional display-only bucket in the ACE Models panel; alias resolution remains flat and unchanged. The built-in coders bucket is supplied by ACE, and custom aliases assigned to coders coalesce with its builtin members.

buckets.description: Optional display-only Models-panel bucket metadata. ACE supplies the built-in coders bucket even without custom members; its description may be overridden here, and custom aliases assigned to coders coalesce with it.

retry.description: Per-provider retry configuration. Keys are provider names (e.g., 'agy', 'claude', 'codex').

max_retries.description: Maximum number of retries on matching errors

error_patterns.description: Substrings to match against error output (case-insensitive)

wait_times.description: Wait times in seconds for each retry attempt. Last value is reused if retries exceed list length.

fallback_model.description: Model to fall back to after all retries are exhausted

continuation_prompt.description: Prompt prefix applied when continuing after a retry

preserve_workspace.description: Preserve the existing workspace when retrying

spawn_new_agent.description: Retry in a fresh detached agent process

vcs_provider.description: Configuration for the VCS provider abstraction layer

provider.description: Name of the VCS provider ('git', 'hg', or 'auto' for auto-detection)

default_hooks.description: Override the default required hooks added to new ChangeSpecs. Each entry is a hook command string (supports '!' and '$' prefixes).

workspace_root.description: Root directory for workspaces. Overridden by SASE_WORKSPACE_ROOT env var. Defaults to $HOME/workspace for git.

pr_tags.description: Key-value tags appended as TAG=VALUE lines to PR commit messages

use_project_pr_prefix.description: Prepend [<project>] to PR titles or PR descriptions.

vcs_repo_completion.description: Repository-name completion inside VCS workflow refs such as #gh:owner/.

enabled.description: Enable repository completion inside VCS workflow refs.

cache_ttl_seconds.description: Seconds before cached repository lists are refreshed.

max_repos.description: Maximum repositories requested from providers and returned to completion callers.

vcs_ref_completion.description: Project, ChangeSpec, and namespace completion at the root of VCS workflow refs such as #gh:.

enabled.description: Enable completion at the root of VCS workflow refs.
Run the commit finalizer after SASE-launched agent turns.

max_passes.description: Maximum follow-up turns the finalizer may run before failing a still-dirty workspace.

github_orgs.description: GitHub organization/user names the user has push access to, used for cloning and PR submission

default_linked_repos.description: Inject the default plans sidecar repository for SASE-managed projects.

repos.description: Repositories related to the current project.

linked.description: Related repositories exposed to launched agents as workspace-matched directories.

sidecar.description: Project-owned sidecar repositories cloned below sase/repos/<name>.

linked_repos.description: Deprecated alias for 'repos.linked'. Still parsed during the compatibility window; prefer 'repos.linked' in new config.

sibling_repos.description: Deprecated alias for 'repos.linked'. Still parsed during the compatibility window; prefer 'repos.linked' in new config.

bead_refresh.description: Remote freshness policy for bead commands using sidecar stores

push_after_commit.description: Controls git push after SDD commits in separate_repo storage. true pushes synchronously, false skips push, and async starts a detached background push.

repo.description: Sidecar SDD repository options for providers that support separate_repo storage

name.description: Optional sidecar SDD repo override. Accepts a repo name or owner/repo; empty uses the provider convention.

push_after_commit.description: When true, run `git push` after `sase bead work` commits sdd/beads/issues.jsonl. Push failures only warn; the local commit is preserved.

workspace.description: Workspace directory layout policy (Phase 1+: sase-3p WorkspaceStore).

root.description: Workspace root policy: 'xdg-state' (default platform state directory), 'adjacent' (legacy opt-in `primary_<num>/` layout), or an absolute path. The `SASE_WORKSPACE_ROOT` environment variable overrides this when set.

project_key.description: Explicit override for the project_key used to namespace managed workspaces. Empty string means derive from the single Git remote (preferred) or the primary path plus a short hash.

cleanup_ttl_days.description: Days before unclaimed managed workspaces are eligible for `sase workspace cleanup --stale`.

xprompt_aliases.description: Aliases for xprompt references, substituted before any other xprompt processing (e.g., {"#gh_sase": "#gh:sase"})

commit_hooks.description: Commands to run before VCS dispatch and after a commit-producing dispatch succeeds.

before.description: Command to run before commit dispatch (e.g., 'just fix'). Empty string means disabled.

after.description: Command to run after a commit is created and, where applicable, pushed. Empty string means disabled.

max_running_agents.description: Maximum number of root user agents that may be running concurrently across all projects.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name governing all SASE wall-clock display and timestamp generation (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'US/Pacific'). Defaults to the system timezone when unset.

use_chezmoi.description: Remap home xprompt paths to chezmoi-managed equivalents under ~/.local/share/chezmoi/home/

xprompts.description: Reusable text templates that can be referenced in prompts

tags.description: Semantic role tags for tag-based xprompt lookup

snippet.description: Opt-in snippet expansion: true for auto trigger word, or a custom trigger string

skill.description: Skill deployment metadata for generated skills

log_skill_use.description: Whether the generated skill includes the first-step audit directive that records its own use (default true)

exposition_port.description: Port for the Prometheus metrics exposition endpoint

health_thresholds.description: Thresholds for the telemetry health traffic-light check

error_rate_warn.description: Error rate percentage to trigger a warning

error_rate_critical.description: Error rate percentage to trigger a critical alert

retry_rate_warn.description: Retry rate percentage to trigger a warning

retry_rate_critical.description: Retry rate percentage to trigger a critical alert

p95_latency_warn.description: P95 latency in seconds to trigger a warning

p95_latency_critical.description: P95 latency in seconds to trigger a critical alert
